steps.content: A familiar warmth brushes against you, pulling you back from the haziness. You open your eyes to see Hecate dabbing sweat from your brow, her face etched with concern.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, are you alright?
Using the shackles to sense the Black Ring has left you deeply fatigued; you must have dozed off while reviewing battle reports.
Yet, the success is its own reward. Your plan to track the Black Ring is progressing perfectly. A satisfied smile touches your lips in answer to her worry.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My plan works. Augustus's troop will find the Black Ring, and Hella will come back. Don't worry. Look—
As you look up, you see the shadow of "Hella" floating above you, her posture one of clear contentment.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Heehee...

steps.speaker: Option
options: We won, and Hella's happy about it too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can you hear her talking?
Hecate shakes her head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay. I can't fully understand her either, but I've found a way to communicate with her. Look.
You shuffle through the documents cluttering your desk. Scattered among the battle reports are the letters and trinkets Hella has sent from her travels.

The shadow swoops in the instant she spots them, flailing her arms with excitement. When you point to a photograph or a particular letter, she bounces in a joyful dance. Her gestures become increasingly animated, as if showing frustration that these static, small tokens could never capture the full breadth of her adventures.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a... cowboy town? Closest one to us, right in WhiteSands. It was her first stop.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Seems like a fun place, full of... scammers? Haha, Hella says she's really mad at them, but looks like she had a lot of fun.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is a big canyon, where their car gave out, right? I heard she got jumped by bandits and ended up robbing them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Look how far they've traveled, all the way into the Outlanders' territory. And she even made friends with the Outlanders. A lot of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Haha... Listen to us, talking about mobilization and war... and Hella's out there actually helping people. Getting along with the Outlanders better than any diplomat we've got.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She never should've gone through all this. We're bringing her home. We have to.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Yeah.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella will be alright. The real her is waiting for you. And she would want you to stay safe. You need to get some rest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We will win.
The phantom of Hella floats down, a gentle wisp upon the air. Though her features remain a blurred portrait, an unusual tenderness radiates from her as she bends to gather you both into a quiet hold.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, we've got news!
You rush immediately to the command console.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is Minos. Do you copy? What's your status? Have you reached the location?

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Broken Blade Squad 3... copy. ████... we've reached... the designated location. The Tide of Ashes and... Black Ring readings... are both extremely intense......... ██...
You anxiously grip the communication device.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Can you send a live feed?

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Interference is severe, visibility zero... ██...can only transmit... sensor readings but... ███...transmission is difficult...

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Ground... ██...shaking, something underground... ████...could be... Aurum Secretum device...██...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Wait, this could be an ambush.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Give us some time to investigate. Stay put—

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Will miss... opportunity... We must proceed...

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Please don't worry about us. This is...████... your order...██... We... will...██... complete the mission...

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: ██...██ Broken Blade Squad 3...██... over...
The communication ends abruptly.
On the battlefield far away from the city, the military troop conducts a final check of their weapons, magazines clicking home into receivers.

Before them, BR-005 lies unsettlingly still. The path is clear—no ash storms, no Apostles lurking—just a wide, exposed road promising an easy victory. Yet a cold dread settles in the veterans' bones. They sense it...
At the end of the open road, a solitary guardian lies in wait. Its master seems confident this true monster is all it will take to crush the warriors foolish enough to take the bait.
